prompt: Create a premium editorial illustration for Beforest, an Indian regenerative landscape and nature-stay brand, intended for a mobile-first website. Use case: illustration-story. Asset 1 of a coordinated series, "a living place to get to know". A small, graceful mature broad-canopy native tree, illustrated with a shallow cross-section of the earth below it: branching roots, soil strata and a subtle flowing water line. One restrained leafy branch, a few natural organic forms. The scene must feel like a quiet field-notebook drawing, tactile hand-drawn ink with subtle coloured-pencil or dry gouache accents, spare confident marks, thoughtful asymmetry, generous negative space. Render as a standalone horizontal vignette roughly 3:2, centred art with generous transparent padding, crisp and legible at 320px wide, no detailed micro-texture that turns muddy at mobile size. Palette exclusively dark earth #342e29, rich red #86312b, warm peach #ffc083, charcoal, small deep blue #002140 water accents. Leaves also earth/red/peach, no green. No frame or solid background: genuine transparent background. No words, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, infographic labels, calendar grids, buildings, people, cartoon mascots, clipart, photorealism, 3D or glowing gradients. This is symbolic illustration, not a depiction of a specific Beforest property. Aim for an elegant Indian literary magazine illustration, warm, grounded, quietly expressive.

Horizontal 3:2 vignette. Palette earth #342e29, rich red #86312b, peach #ffc083, small deep blue #002140 rain accents. No green; foliage in muted rust and peach. Genuine transparent background with no gradient, coloured rectangle, background haze, dark vignette, border or glow. No text, numbers, logos, arrows, people, buildings, mascots, clipart, glossy 3D, photorealism or calendars. A symbolic seasons illustration, not an actual Beforest property photograph. Keep all three tree moments comfortably inside the canvas, don't crop them.
